govt_add.name: Koshi Province Level 7 and 8 officer posts (Notice 106/2083-84): 69 seats
govt_add.level: Seventh level officer and eighth level Medical Officer posts of the Koshi local service (engineering, agriculture, veterinary, livestock, fisheries, education, health and administration), run by the Koshi Province Public Service Commission in Biratnagar
govt_add.need: Bachelor level degree in the subject each post names (Civil Engineering, BSc Agriculture, BVSc and AH, Public Health, Medical Laboratory Technology, Law, Management or Commerce for Accounts, any bachelor degree for Section Officer); MBBS for Medical Officer. Health posts need valid council registration. Everything must be complete by the regular deadline
govt_add.age: 21 to 35 years, up to 40 for women and persons with disabilities, 21 to 45 for health service posts; permanent employees of the listed services are exempt from the upper limit
govt_add.body: Province Public Service Commission, Koshi Province, Biratnagar (psc.koshi.gov.np, applications at psconline.p1.gov.np)
stages: Written examination

Post wise papers, centre announced later. Medical Officer 2083/09/04 and 05; Civil Engineer 09 and 10 (Building and Architecture group 04 and 05); Veterinary 11 and 12; Agriculture Extension, Horticulture and Crop 18 and 19; Livestock 25 and 26; Fisheries 27; Education 2083/10/01 to 03; Medical Lab 10/09 and 10; Public Health 10/16 and 17; Law 10/09 and 10; Section and Accounts Officer first paper 09/15 and later papers 10/23 to 25. Every date is Bikram Sambat.
Computer skill test, group assessment and interview
Where the post syllabus says so, after the written result. A candidate who qualifies in more than one inclusive group attends these stages once.
subjects: General knowledge, province and local government law
Post specific technical or administrative paper
Computer skill test where the syllabus says so
prep: Get the syllabus from the commission of your province, not from a federal PSC page
Open, inclusive and inter level groups are separate advertisements, and each extra group costs extra, so list your groups before you pay
Qualification, age and council registration must be complete on the regular deadline; the double fee date does not extend them
govt_add.note: Notice 106/2083-84 (open and inclusive, published 2083/06/26) lists 69 seats: 49 technical (6 Medical Officer at level 8, Engineer 13, Agriculture, Horticulture and Crop officers 11, Veterinary 6, Education 6, Public Health 3, Livestock 2, Fisheries 1, Medical Lab 1) and 20 non technical (Section and Accounts Officer 18, Law Officer 2), counted from the advertisement table. Fee NPR 1,200 for level 7 or 8 plus NPR 400 for each extra group; regular deadline 2083/07/15 (about 1 November 2026) and double fee to 2083/07/22, fee payment by 2083/07/23, so the call is now closed. The same day the commission advertised 29 promotion posts (Notice 104 level 9 with 1 post and Notice 105 level 7 with 28 posts) for serving staff only, fee NPR 1,200 or 2,000, on paper at the Biratnagar office until 2083/07/24. The notice prints no salary. Read the post wise syllabus on psc.koshi.gov.np; the next Koshi call follows the annual 2083/84 calendar (1 Shrawan 2083 to 32 Ashad 2084).

govt_add.name: Israel care worker (Government to Government, long term care centres)
govt_add.level: Government to government hiring of Nepali auxiliary care workers for Israeli long term care centres for people with severe disabilities, run by the Department of Foreign Employment (DoFE)
govt_add.need: SEE pass plus at least 15 months of ANM or CMA study, or +2 pass plus at least 3 months of caregiving training from a provider recognised by the Government of Nepal. Passport valid for at least 3 more years. Nobody who worked in Israel before, and no parent, spouse or child living or working there. Height at least 1.5 m and weight at least 45 kg
govt_add.body: Department of Foreign Employment, Ministry of Labour, with the Israeli Population and Immigration Authority; online at ferms.dofe.gov.np
stages: Online application

One free form on ferms.dofe.gov.np in a window of about three weeks. The 2026 calls ran 31 May to 21 June (2,300 workers, deadline 2083/03/07 at noon) and 8 September to 12 October (1,464 workers: 1,132 women and 332 men). No agency is involved and nobody can sell a seat.
Selection and checks
Pages describe a roster check and a lottery run by DoFE, then document checks, a medical and a pre departure orientation. The notice text of the call is the authority for the exact order.
Visa and travel
Care worker visa for one year, extendable year by year; pages quote a stay of up to 5 years and up to 63 months. The labour permit steps are in the labour permit guide.
subjects: Caregiving training certificate (3 months, or 15 months ANM or CMA)
Medical fitness for lifting and night care
prep: Finish the training first: a call gives only about 21 days and a certificate cannot be made in that time
Check the training provider is recognised by the Government of Nepal before you pay
Use only ferms.dofe.gov.np; a call is free of agent fees and anyone asking for money for a seat is a fraud
govt_add.note: Pay is NIS 6,443.85 a month in the DoFE notice as Onlinekhabar printed it (two pages print 6,443.65 and 6,443 and one older text 5,884), about NPR 310,000 to 350,000 depending on the exchange rate, for 42 hours a week with one day off, overtime and leave by Israeli law. Both 2026 windows are closed on 19 November 2026; watch dofe.gov.np and the DoFE Facebook page for the next call. The first call listed 2,300 posts and the second 1,464, so the demand changes by call. Requirement for the training differs between pages (3 months, 15 months, or a 390 hour CTEVT course); read the notice of the call you apply in. The notice quoted no application fee, but the labour permit, medical, insurance and Welfare Fund costs in the guide still apply.

govt_add.name: PLAB (UK doctor test for foreign medical graduates)
govt_add.level: Professional and Linguistic Assessments Board test run by the General Medical Council (GMC) to register as a doctor in the UK
govt_add.need: MBBS from a school the GMC recognises, English language evidence (IELTS Academic or OET Medicine) and a GMC online account.
stages: PLAB 1

Written computer test at an approved test centre, booked through GMC Online once your English evidence is accepted. Fee GBP 283 from 1 April 2026 (GBP 273 before). Pages show the test windows several times a year; check which centre is nearest to you on the GMC site.
PLAB 2
Practical exam of 16 stations of 8 minutes, held only at the GMC centres in Manchester, so travel and a UK visit are extra. Fee GBP 1,036 from 1 April 2026 (GBP 998 before).
GMC registration
After both parts you apply for full registration with a licence to practise and pay the GMC registration fee. A job offer or clinical attachment is the next hurdle.
subjects: Medicine, surgery, obstetrics and gynaecology, paediatrics, psychiatry
Emergency care and acute medicine at second year foundation doctor level
Communication skills and clinical examination in the OSCE
prep: The standard is a doctor starting the second year of UK Foundation training, so study UK guidelines (NICE) and not only exam banks
Budget GBP 1,319 for first time exam fees alone, plus English test, flights, visa and Manchester stay
Do not pay a fixer for a test seat: all booking is in your own GMC Online account
govt_add.note: Both fees are the figures printed from 1 April 2026 on three guides that copy the GMC fee table; the GMC pages did not load from the VM. Cancellation fees apply (PLAB 1 GBP 28.30 more than 42 days before, full fee later; PLAB 2 GBP 103.60 more than 42 days before, GBP 518 at 42 to 28 days, full fee later). PLAB is only one route into the UK; check the GMC for newer routes before you plan.

govt_add.name: USMLE and ECFMG certification (US doctor route for foreign graduates)
govt_add.level: United States Medical Licensing Examination Step 1 and Step 2 CK, with ECFMG certification, for international medical graduates who want US residency
govt_add.need: MBBS from a medical school listed by the ECFMG and, for certification, a MyIntealth account, ECFMG application and credential verification of your diploma and transcript. Check the school status in the Intealth directory first
govt_add.body: Intealth and ECFMG (identity, application, certification) and the Federation of State Medical Boards at usmle.fsmb.org (exam registration since 12 January 2026), tests at Prometric centres
stages: ECFMG account and application

MyIntealth account about USD 110, ECFMG certification application about USD 580 (one page still prints 560), credential verification for the diploma and the transcript about USD 220 together (two pages print 110 each). New FSMB portal account USD 75 (one time, 2026).
USMLE Step 1 and Step 2 CK

Each exam costs USD 695 plus an international surcharge outside the US and Canada: USD 210 for Step 1 (USD 905 in all) and USD 235 for Step 2 CK (USD 930 in all). Step 1 is pass or fail; Step 2 CK is scored. Step 3 costs USD 955 and is only held in the US.
Certification and Match
After passing both steps and the clinical skills or Pathways requirement, ECFMG certifies you; ERAS and Match fees come on top when you apply to residencies.
subjects: Basic sciences and mechanisms of disease (Step 1)
Clinical medicine, diagnosis and management (Step 2 CK)
prep: Budget about USD 3,600 to 3,800 just to reach ECFMG certification from Nepal before travel and coaching
Check the Prometric site for the nearest test centre, because none is confirmed in Nepal on the pages read
Prepare for a long route: many foreign graduates take several years to match, so keep a Nepal licence and job plan alongside
govt_add.note: Fees are the 2026 figures printed on three IMG guides in June to November 2026; they agree on USD 695 and the two surcharges and differ by USD 10 to 20 on the ECFMG items. The official ECFMG and FSMB pages did not load from the VM. Always read the live fee page before paying; the transfer of IMG registration from ECFMG to FSMB on 12 January 2026 changed where you pay.

govt_add.name: NCLEX-RN (US nurse licensing exam)
govt_add.level: National Council Licensure Examination for registered nurses, run by NCSBN and delivered by Pearson VUE, the entry step to a US nursing licence
govt_add.need: A nursing degree (BSc Nursing or equivalent), a Nepal Nursing Council licence, a credential evaluation where your chosen US state board asks for one, and English evidence if the board asks. Apply first to a US state board of nursing; it issues your eligibility, then you register with Pearson VUE and receive an Authorization to Test
govt_add.body: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (ncsbn.org) with a US state board of nursing; exam delivered by Pearson VUE
stages: State board application
Apply to a board that accepts foreign educated nurses; state fees are quoted at USD 75 to 400 plus credential evaluation of about USD 200 to 400.
Register with Pearson VUE

Registration fee USD 200 and, outside the US, Canada and Australia, an international scheduling fee of USD 150. The Authorization to Test is valid for about 90 days, so book soon after you receive it.
Sit the exam

Computer adaptive test, held all year with no fixed dates. A Kathmandu coaching site says there is no NCLEX test centre in Nepal and nurses test in India; confirm the nearest centre on pearsonvue.com/nclex.
subjects: Health promotion, psychosocial and physiological integrity
Pharmacology, prioritisation and next generation case study questions
prep: Pass is not the end: you also need a visa and an employer or a green card route, so ask what the job market and visa waits are before paying for coaching
Keep your NNC licence current, because a state board may ask for it
Treat quotes of NPR 200,000 to 350,000 for the whole process as typical, and compare them with the USD 350 in exam fees
govt_add.note: Exam fee USD 200 plus USD 150 international scheduling is the figure printed by four pages in 2026; total cost with state, evaluation and travel is about USD 1,000 to 1,500 on two of them. The NCSBN page did not load from the VM. The nurse licence in Nepal (NLEN) is a separate exam in this list.

govt_add.name: OET (Occupational English Test for health professionals)
govt_add.level: English test built on healthcare tasks, used by nursing, medical and other health councils to register in the UK, Australia, New Zealand and Ireland
govt_add.need: A health profession among the 12 OET covers (medicine, nursing, dentistry, pharmacy, physiotherapy and others). Medicine, nursing, dentistry, pharmacy, physiotherapy, radiography and veterinary science can sit the paper test; all 12 professions can sit the computer and OET@Home versions
stages: Book the test

Booking is online on oet.com with a card. The full test with all four parts costs AUD 587 anywhere in the world (USD 455 for computer and OET@Home bookings in the USA). Nepal pages print about NPR 61,000 and about NPR 78,000 to 80,000, which differ with the exchange rate, so convert the AUD price yourself.
Sit the test

Listening, Reading, Writing (a referral or discharge letter in your profession) and Speaking (role play with a patient). The computer test is offered at authorised venues in Kathmandu and OET@Home is available for eligible candidates.
Result and use
Computer and OET@Home results come in about 48 hours and paper results in about 12 days. The result is valid for 2 years from the test date, and your regulator sets the grades it needs in each part.
subjects: Role play speaking with a patient
prep: Check the exact grades your council asks for in each part, because a B in every part is common but not universal
Practise writing the letter for your own profession, since that part decides many failures
Rescheduling costs AUD 120 (more after booking closes) and cancelling gives back AUD 460 or 380, so book only when ready
govt_add.note: Fee, formats and change charges are from oet-bank.com of 1 November 2026; the Kathmandu venue and the prep centres come from scolarnepal.com. Retaking a part is only possible on paper tests outside the USA after one full test (one part AUD 315, two AUD 415, three AUD 515). It costs more than IELTS, but it is built for nurses and doctors.

guides_add.name: Driving licence (new, online system)
steps: Check the minimum age for your category: 16 years for motorcycle and scooter (A, K), 18 for car, jeep and van (B), 21 for heavy vehicles

Open the portal of your province (Bagmati: edlvrs.bagamati.gov.np) and sign in; scanning the QR code on your National ID or the Nagarik App fills the form. Since 1 Shrawan 2083 the old national form has moved to the seven province portals
Get the health check from an approved doctor (one guide prints NPR 200 to 300)
Pick the category and the transport office where you will sit the tests, then pay the application fee online (NPR 500 on the DoTM question books, up to 1,000 on another guide)
Book and sit the 25 question written test on a computer at the transport office; pass marks are printed differently on different guides, so read the portal
Sit the practical trial on the trial track on your booked date; a retest costs about NPR 400 to 500

Pay the licence fee online after you pass: NPR 1,500 (motorcycle) and 2,000 (car) in the old DoTM books, NPR 3,000 (A, K) and 4,000 (B, 5,000 in Madhesh) in the 2083/84 province fee tables, so the portal shows the amount that applies to you
Collect the smart card from the office; the card normally takes a few working days to print
docs: Nagarik App or National ID QR code

route_note_add.skill-training: Driving is a skill you can add at 16 (motorcycle) or 18 (car). Licences are applied for on the province portals since 1 Shrawan 2083; read the driving licence guide for the steps, ages and fees, and note that guides disagree on fees (NPR 1,500 to 4,000 for a first licence), so trust the amount your portal shows.
route_note_add.foreign-lang-work: Israel hires Nepali care workers through government calls run by DoFE (2,300 posts in May and June 2026 and 1,464 in September and October 2026): SEE with 15 months of ANM or CMA study, or +2 with 3 months of caregiving training, age 25 to 45, apply only at ferms.dofe.gov.np with no agent.
route_note_add.mbbs: After MBBS in Nepal you finish the one year internship and sit the NMCLE. Doctors who want the UK sit PLAB 1 and 2 (GBP 283 and 1,036 from April 2026) and doctors who want the US take USMLE Step 1 and 2 CK (USD 695 each plus a USD 210 and 235 surcharge outside the US). See the exam entries before you pay a coaching centre.
route_note_add.bsc-nursing: After BSc Nursing you register with the Nepal Nursing Council. Nurses who want the US sit the NCLEX-RN (USD 200 plus USD 150 international scheduling, no test centre in Nepal on the pages read).

govt_note_add.l-eps: 2026 round (checked 19 November 2026): the first phase application ran 27 July to 2 August 2026 (11 to 17 Shrawan 2083) at eoers.epsnepal.gov.np, fee USD 28, for Nepali citizens aged 18 to 39 (born 28 July 1986 to 27 July 2008). One 2026 guide gives an estimated quota of 7,200 passes (manufacturing 5,000, agriculture and livestock 2,000, service 100, forestry 100), against the 3,500 and 1,800 above, so read the quota in the notice. Computer test (UBT, 20 Reading and 20 Listening questions) at the UBT hall of the National Vocational Training Institute in Bhaisepati, Lalitpur, in blocks from 17 November 2026 to 25 February 2027: Service 1 on 17 to 19 November, Forestry 18 and 19 November, Agriculture and Livestock 20 November to 10 December, Manufacturing 11 to 22 December, 4 to 21 January, 29 January to 5 February and 10 to 25 February. The day before your slot you give a fingerprint at the EPS Korea branch in Gwarko; on exam day arrive two hours early with the colour admit card and original passport, with no phone, watch or bag; cheating means a four year ban. Pages print the EPS medical at about NPR 7,300. No next application window is announced; it will be a notice on epsnepal.gov.np.
govt_note_add.l-topik: In 2026 the paper TOPIK was held in Kathmandu on 17 May and 15 November (the November test organised by King Sejong Institute Kathmandu), with results for the 15 November test due on 22 December 2026 on topik.go.kr; the guide takes this from the NIIED overseas list of 1 September 2026. Nepal has only paper centres for TOPIK in 2026 and not every sitting is held in every city, so read the notice on topik.go.kr before you plan.
govt_note_add.l-jlpt: The December 2026 sitting is on Sunday 6 December 2026 worldwide (jlpt.jp); the next are Sunday 4 July 2027 and Sunday 5 December 2027. Online results come around the end of January 2027. Registration for the December sitting normally closes in the autumn, so if you missed it plan for July 2027 and watch the registration notice of your city, because some cities hold only the July test. Fee in Japan is JPY 7,500 per level; the Nepal fee depends on the host institution, so read its notice.
govt_note_add.l-ielts: 2026 fees in Nepal differ by page and date: NPR 33,000 for computer and 36,200 for paper on one April 2026 guide, and NPR 36,000 for computer and 36,400 for UKVI computer on September and August 2026 guides, with British Council and IDP printing nearly the same price. Paper IELTS is being phased out worldwide with the last paper dates around late June 2026, although one September guide still lists IDP paper at NPR 36,200. Computer tests run up to seven days a week in Kathmandu and also in Butwal, Chitwan, Itahari and Pokhara through the British Council; the computer result comes in 1 to 5 days. Confirm the live fee on the page of your provider.
govt_note_add.l-pte: PTE Academic costs USD 248.60 on pearsonpte.com as read on 24 October 2026 (PTE Academic UKVI and PTE Core cost the same), about NPR 37,834 at the NRB selling rate of 152.19 on 20 October 2026. Older pages print USD 220 to 245 or about NPR 27,000 to 33,000. There are 11 test centres in Nepal (Lalitpur, Kathmandu, Pokhara, Tilottama and Itahari among them), results come in about 48 hours (up to five business days), and rescheduling is free or fully refunded more than 14 full days before the test.

faq_add.q: How much does it cost to become a doctor in the UK after MBBS in Nepal?
faq_add.a: Exam fees alone are GBP 1,319 for a first time pass: PLAB 1 costs GBP 283 and PLAB 2 costs GBP 1,036 (both from 1 April 2026, up from 273 and 998). PLAB 2 is held only in Manchester, so add flights, a UK visitor visa and a stay. You also need an English test (IELTS Academic or OET Medicine), the GMC registration fee and a job or clinical attachment. The test checks the level of a doctor starting the second year of UK Foundation training. Book only through your own GMC Online account; no agent can buy you a seat.

faq_add.q: What does the USMLE route to the US cost from Nepal?
faq_add.a: Each of Step 1 and Step 2 CK costs USD 695, plus an international surcharge outside the US and Canada of USD 210 for Step 1 and USD 235 for Step 2 CK, so USD 905 and USD 930. Before that you pay ECFMG about USD 110 for the account, about USD 580 for the certification application and about USD 220 for credential verification, plus a USD 75 FSMB portal account. Three guides total about USD 3,600 to 3,800 to reach ECFMG certification, before coaching, travel, ERAS and Match fees. Since 12 January 2026 you register for the exams at usmle.fsmb.org. Ask whether your medical school is listed before you pay anything.

faq_add.q: Can a Nepali nurse take the NCLEX and work in the US?
faq_add.a: Only after a state board accepts your application. You apply to a US state board of nursing, pay its fee and a credential evaluation, then register with Pearson VUE for USD 200 plus a USD 150 international scheduling fee and book within about 90 days of the Authorization to Test. A Kathmandu coaching site says there is no NCLEX centre in Nepal and nurses test in India, so confirm the nearest centre on the Pearson VUE site. Passing the exam does not give a visa or a job, so ask about visa waits and employers first. Keep your Nepal Nursing Council licence current.

faq_add.q: Can I go to Israel as a care worker after SEE or +2?
faq_add.a: Yes, through a government call from the Department of Foreign Employment, never through an agent. You need SEE plus at least 15 months of ANM or CMA study, or +2 plus at least 3 months of caregiving training from a recognised provider, age 25 to 45, at least 1.5 m tall and 45 kg, a passport with 3 more years of validity, and no family member living or working in Israel. The 2026 calls were 2,300 posts (31 May to 21 June) and 1,464 posts (8 September to 12 October), applied for at ferms.dofe.gov.np in about three weeks. Pay is NIS 6,443.85 a month for 42 hours a week in the notice. Both calls are closed now, so finish the training and watch dofe.gov.np.

faq_add.q: At what age can I get a driving licence in Nepal and how do I apply?
faq_add.a: You can get a motorcycle or scooter licence (A, K) at 16, a car, jeep or van licence (B) at 18, and a heavy vehicle licence at 21. Since 1 Shrawan 2083 you apply online on your province portal (for Bagmati, edlvrs.bagamati.gov.np); scanning the QR code in your National ID or the Nagarik App fills the form. You still go in person for the health check, the 25 question computer test, the trial and the card. Fees differ between guides: NPR 1,500 to 2,000 in the old DoTM question books and NPR 3,000 for A, K and 4,000 for B (5,000 in Madhesh) in the 2083/84 province fee tables, so trust the amount your portal shows.

faq_add.q: What was the Koshi Lok Sewa call of 2083/84 and who could apply?
faq_add.a: Koshi Province Public Service Commission in Biratnagar advertised 69 open and inclusive seats on 2083/06/26 (Notice 106/2083-84): 49 technical (6 Medical Officers at level 8, 13 Engineers, 11 agriculture, horticulture and crop officers, 6 veterinary, 6 education, 3 public health, 2 livestock, 1 fisheries, 1 medical lab) and 20 non technical (18 Section and Accounts Officers, 2 Law Officers). You needed a bachelor degree in the post subject (MBBS for Medical Officer), age 21 to 35 (40 for women and persons with disabilities, 45 for health posts) and council registration for health posts. The fee was NPR 1,200 plus NPR 400 per extra group and the regular deadline was 2083/07/15, so it is closed; written papers run from 2083/09/04.

faq_add.q: When is the EPS-TOPIK exam for Korea in 2026 and who can sit?
faq_add.a: The 2026 first phase application ran 27 July to 2 August on eoers.epsnepal.gov.np, so it is closed. Applicants had to be Nepali citizens aged 18 to 39 (born 28 July 1986 to 27 July 2008) and paid USD 28. The computer test (20 Reading and 20 Listening questions) runs at the UBT hall in Bhaisepati, Lalitpur, in blocks from 17 November 2026 to 25 February 2027: Service and Forestry first, Agriculture and Livestock to 10 December, then Manufacturing in four blocks. Give a fingerprint at the Gwarko branch the day before, arrive two hours early with the admit card and passport, and bring no phone or bag. One guide estimates 7,200 passes in all. The next application window will be a notice on epsnepal.gov.np.

faq_add.q: Which English test should a nurse or doctor from Nepal take, OET or IELTS?
faq_add.a: Ask your regulator first, because it sets the test and the grade. OET is built on healthcare tasks (a patient letter and a role play) and is accepted by nursing and medical councils in the UK, Australia, New Zealand and Ireland. It costs AUD 587 for the full test, more than IELTS, which was NPR 33,000 to 36,000 on computer in 2026 pages (PTE Academic is USD 248.60, about NPR 37,800). OET computer tests are held at authorised venues in Kathmandu and OET@Home is available, results come in about 48 hours and are valid for 2 years. A retake of single parts is only possible on paper tests outside the USA.

faq_add.q: How much do IELTS, PTE, JLPT and TOPIK cost and when are they held in Nepal in 2026 and 2027?
faq_add.a: IELTS computer costs about NPR 33,000 to 36,000 (paper, if still offered, NPR 36,200) and PTE Academic costs USD 248.60, about NPR 37,800 at the NRB rate of 20 October 2026, with 11 PTE centres in Nepal. The JLPT is on Sunday 6 December 2026, then Sunday 4 July 2027 and 5 December 2027, with online results around the end of January 2027. The paper TOPIK was held in Kathmandu on 17 May and 15 November 2026 and the 15 November result is due on 22 December 2026. Fees change with the exchange rate, so confirm the live price on the provider page before you pay.
